did.unittitle: Thomas Sieniewicz collection of glass negatives of New Haven
did.abstract: The collection consists of forty-two glass negatives depicting New Haven, Connecticut, businesses and residences.

separatedmaterial.head: Separated Materials
separatedmaterial.p: Glass negative of H. L. Brown Merchant Tailor was discarded after scanning due to condition.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The collection is a gift of Thomas Sieniewicz, 1998.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: The materials are open for research.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Copyright status for collection materials is unknown, though much of the material in this collection is likely in the public domain. Transmission or reproduction of materials protected by U.S. Copyright Law (Title 17, U.S.C.) beyond that allowed by fair use requires the written permission of the copyright owners. altformavail.head: Existence and Location of Copies
altformavail.p: Some glass negatives are available in digital form.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Thomas Sieniewicz Collection of Glass Negatives of New Haven (MS 1819). Manuscripts and Archives, Yale University Library.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The collection consists of forty-two glass negatives depicting New Haven, Connecticut, businesses and residences. The images are of business facades and building exteriors with individuals standing at the entrances.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The collection is arranged in two sections, Businesses and Residences, and alphabetically therein.
